title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to Eurydike, the roofless hall of the Kothringi knights north of Gideon, to open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone; the knights once guarded the kings' road to the Root, the place under the sea where every Hist's roots meet and the Eye of Argonia lies. The knights' dead walk the barracks wing, and the Unbound got there before me. I'm to search the Unbound's packs by their fire on the way to the tomb. I may fight, slip past, or turn the dead with Restoration. All of it is a trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, which lies at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea; the order wants it found before the Unbound reach it.
objectives: Search the Unbound's packs in Eurydike's barracks wing. (marker: Unbound Pack)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike; the Unbound are there ahead of me. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Go to Eurydike and search the Unbound's packs on the way to the tomb.
plan.ways: Fight the dead and the Unbound, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka of the order (Toh-Reel-Ka, Helstrom). The keystone opens the knight-captain tomb here at Eurydike, a trail toward the Eye of Argonia, a jewel said to heal every tree, at the Root under the sea. The Unbound are ahead of me and want it too.
Search the Unbound packs in the barracks wing of Eurydike, then reach the tomb.
Fight the dead or the Unbound, slip past quietly (my preferred way), or turn the dead with Restoration.
I do not know exactly what the Eye of Argonia is, what is in the tomb, what the Collector wants, or how the Unbound knew. I can learn by talking to people and reading what I find.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the Unbound's packs were bottles of the grey paste they call "the seal". It is a paralysis poison: it numbs a tree's scar shut. The Unbound drain a tree and then poison it. If they wanted the trees dead they could kill them, so why seal a tree they drain? I'm to open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone.
objectives: Open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone and search it. (marker: Door to Knight-Captain's Tomb, Knight-Captain's Tomb Chest)

plan.going: The seal is a paralysis poison. I do not know why the Unbound seal trees they drain: that question is open. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Open the tomb with the keystone and search the knight-captain's chest.
plan.ways: The keystone is the door's key; the dead and the Unbound may still be about.
terms: paralysis poison (the seal): the item's name and journal 20

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. The Unbound packs held grey paste called the seal, a paralysis poison that numbs a tree scar shut. The Unbound drain trees then seal them, which is puzzling if they wanted them dead. The tomb may lead to the Eye of Argonia.
Open the knight-captain tomb door at Eurydike with the keystone and search the chest inside.
Use the keystone on the door quietly; avoid the Restless Knight and the Unbound Digger, or fight or turn the dead if needed.
I do not understand why the Unbound seal trees they drain, or what the Eye truly is. I may learn from the tomb or from people.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the knight-captain's tomb lay a bronze disc stamped with a mine's mark, a pick crossed with a tower. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the bronze disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The disc bears a mine's mark; I do not know which mine. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.

answers: I opened the tomb with the keystone and took a bronze disc stamped with a mine mark, a pick crossed with a tower. It is another step on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, ahead of the Unbound.
Bring the disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Go straight to Nesh-Deeka; I could also keep the disc and look into the mine mark myself, but I work for her.
I do not know which mine the mark means, what the Eye is, or why the Unbound seal trees. Nesh-Deeka may know.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka knew the mark: Vicrium, an old mine in the clay country behind Seafalls, in the east. She already knew the Unbound had been at Eurydike. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and would not answer why they seal the trees. She paid me 100 gold. The question stays with me.

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium. Why the Unbound seal the trees is still open; Nesh-Deeka knows where they go and will not say how. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN10 starts; its first entry marks Vicrium.
terms: Vicrium: Nesh-Deeka: an old mine behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei

answers: The quest is done. The disc bears the mark of Vicrium, an old ochre and alum mine in the clay country behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei, where the knights kept a strongbox. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold, knew the Unbound were at Eurydike, and said only "we listen".
Nothing set yet; likely Vicrium near Seafalls next, if Nesh-Deeka sends me.
Ask her more, or head to Vicrium on my own.
I do not know how she knows what the Unbound do, why the Unbound seal trees, or what the Eye truly is.
